name: local-excalidraw
description: Create, edit, and preview local Excalidraw drawings in Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Edit and preview local Excalidraw drawings
interface.longDescription: Work with drawings in a folder you choose and display saved changes in Codex’s browser side panel. Requires a separately configured local Local Excalidraw MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Show a drawing in the side panel.
Create an architecture diagram in my Excalidraw folder.
Update an existing drawing and preview the saved result.
